metadata.description: llmlint: ignore[shell_test_tiers_stay_split] This suite drives only git, python3 and loopback servers on 127.0.0.1, which every leg carries and which reach no network; it installs nothing, and ran in 5 s (measured with `just nx run llmlint-tooling:test-plugins --skipNxCache`). A case that adds an install, a non-base host tool or a real network reach belongs in a split project, as llmlint-resolution and witness-search-git are.

llmlint: ignore[shell_test_tiers_stay_split] This suite drives only git, python3 and loopback servers on 127.0.0.1, which every leg carries and which reach no network; it installs nothing, and ran in 2 s (measured with `just nx run llmlint-tooling:test-diff --skipNxCache`). A case that adds an install, a non-base host tool or a real network reach belongs in a split project, as llmlint-resolution and witness-search-git are.
